name: Skirmish at Echo Ridge
summary: In Northshire Valley, recruits strike at kobolds in Echo Ridge Mine. Marshal McBride ordered the attack after scouts found the mine overrun.

sections.title: Purging the Mine
sections.body: Marshal McBride sends recruits against the kobolds in Echo Ridge Mine. Scouts found the mine overrun, and the garrison fears the creatures will strengthen their hold if left alone. The kobolds dig through the tunnels, gather stolen resources, and multiply. Recruits must thin their numbers to protect Northshire Valley, with its farms and spiritual retreat.

sections.title: A Thin Defense
sections.body: New recruits are sent into the mine because the Stormwind Army is stretched thin. Garrison forces guard the southern borders, while unrest is rumored across Elwynn. Officers like McBride must call on willing hands. A recruit who proves reliable at Echo Ridge earns the army’s respect and is ready for more difficult work elsewhere in the kingdom.

faq.q: Why are kobolds infesting the Echo Ridge Mine?
faq.answer: Kobolds are drawn to mineral-rich tunnels and abandoned quarries. With Stormwind’s forces stretched thin, they can enter unguarded places like Echo Ridge to dig burrows, hoard gold, and claim underground shelter.
Marshal McBride orders the skirmish. He commands the Stormwind Army forces at Northshire Abbey and oversees the valley’s defense with limited manpower.

faq.q: What is the strategic importance of Echo Ridge Mine?
faq.answer: Echo Ridge Mine holds stone and ore needed to maintain Northshire and help rebuild Stormwind. Kobolds on Northshire’s northern border threaten the abbey and nearby vineyards.

faq.q: Where does this mission lead next?
faq.answer: After the first kobold laborers are cleared from the mine, Marshal McBride sends you toward Goldshire to aid the region’s defense.

faq.q: Why doesn't the Stormwind Army clear the mine themselves?
faq.answer: Stormwind’s forces are short on soldiers, defending distant borders and answering bandit attacks across Elwynn. McBride relies on new recruits for local threats while seasoned guards hold defensive lines.

faq.q: Are kobolds intelligent enough to be an organized military threat?
faq.answer: Kobold laborers are cowardly and simple-minded alone, but territorial and aggressive in numbers. Left unchecked, they dig winding tunnels, set traps in caverns, and draw larger, better-armed vermin.

angles.text: As a human, clearing Echo Ridge is your first true test of arms in defense of your ancestral kingdom. You prove your mettle to Stormwind’s officers.
As an Alliance member, you help reclaim mines that hold stone and ore for rebuilding and fortifying human settlements after the war.
As a warrior, you face swarming kobold workers in close quarters, among the first entrenched foes you meet.
As a miner, you help make it possible to safely dig and smelt valuable mineral veins across Northshire Valley.
